healthcare.label: Healthcare / Hospital System
healthcare.description: Large hospital network with strict HIPAA compliance requirements, high-sensitivity patient data, and 24/7 SOC coverage.
healthcare.notes: Regulatory multiplier reflects HIPAA breach cost exposure and mandatory 72-hour notification window.

finserv.label: Financial Services / Bank
finserv.description: Tier-1 bank with PCI-DSS and SOX obligations, high-volume transaction monitoring, and dedicated threat intel team.
finserv.notes: High V due to transaction alert volume. Regulatory multiplier captures PCI-DSS fine exposure and reputational cost of breach.

manufacturing.label: Manufacturing / OT Environment
manufacturing.description: Industrial manufacturer with OT/IT convergence, CISA critical infrastructure classification, and lean SOC team.
manufacturing.notes: Lower V reflects OT alert volume. Lean SOC team means higher per-alert analyst time and slower phase-3 qualification.

generic.label: Generic Enterprise
generic.description: Mid-market enterprise with standard security posture, mixed cloud/on-prem footprint, and shared SOC function.
generic.notes: Baseline archetype. Used as default when no industry is specified. Matches validated SOC Copilot pilot configuration.
